name: Villain Wonderland
source:
In Villain Wonderland, players play the role of Canaria, a sweet and beautiful fairy and a famous diva of the fairy kingdom. Yet, her seemingly perfect life is brought down by her wings, for she was born with wings too small to even let her fly like other fairies.

One day, Canaria's trusted manager Ivan offers her a chance to cure her wings. But before her dream can come true, she has to play the part of a fairy godmother who helps those in need from the different worlds and realms. As fate would have it, the ones most in need of happiness are villains of the most well-known fairy tales. Thus, Canaria sets out with her unique magic, "Siren Song", which brings happiness to everyone who listens to it. 

Villain Wonderland will bring a unique twist to the fairy tales that everyone knows and loves. Players will be able to discover the untold stories of iconic villains such as the Wolf from Red Riding Hood, Hunter from the Beauty and the Beast, the Stepbrother of Cinderella, and more.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221129000720/https://agate.id/news/bring-happiness-to-fairytale-villains-in-new-memories-chat-story-villain-wonderland/]Agate[/url]]
translation:
在《反派仙境》中，玩家扮演加那利，一位甜美美丽的仙女，也是仙界著名的天后。然而，她看似完美的生活却被她的翅膀击垮了，因为她生来的翅膀太小，甚至无法让她像其他仙女一样飞翔。

有一天，加那利岛值得信赖的经理伊万为她提供了一个治愈翅膀的机会。但在她的梦想实现之前，她必须扮演仙女教母的角色，帮助来自不同世界和领域的有需要的人。命中注定，最需要幸福的人就是最著名的童话故事中的反派。于是，加那利开始施展她独特的魔法“海妖之歌”，为每一个聆听它的人带来欢乐。

《反派仙境》将为大家熟知和喜爱的童话故事带来独特的转折。玩家将能够发现标志性反派的不为人知的故事，例如《小红帽》中的狼、《美女与野兽》中的猎人、灰姑娘的继兄弟等等。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221129000720/https://agate.id/news/bring-happiness-to-fairytale-villains-in-new-memories-chat-story-villain-wonderland/]玛瑙[/url]]
